title: Two automatic fixture-replay turns in one Realtime session
goal: Prove that two saved private utterance fixtures each produce one completed response in one continuous Realtime session, followed by clean wake recovery.
preconditions: The loopback Realtime host is launched and armed once with configured OpenAI access.
Private wake, turn-1, and turn-2 fixtures have been recorded once and retain matching local integrity metadata.

evidence.offline: The deterministic oracle evaluates sanitized lifecycle reports without devices, network, credentials, audio, or sleeps.
evidence.fixture_replay: After one-time private recording, the runner automatically replays wake, turn-1, and turn-2 with no fresh human speech.
